title: Internal: Claim Verification Practice in LTO Audit Runs

claims.text: Refute-first heterogeneous judgment produces lower false-positive verdicts than confirm-first judgment on the same claim set.
A completeness critic pass finds at least one unverified claim that the primary verifier missed.
Evidence that cannot be reproduced from a frozen path:line reference or deterministic command output should not be used to upgrade a claim from unverified to verified.
Fan-out across multiple orthogonal search angles (by source type, entity, and time window) surfaces more evidence items than single-angle search.

hypotheses.text: Refute-first judgment: when auditors default to 'refuted if uncertain', surviving claims have higher precision.
Completeness critic finds ≥1 missed unverified claim per 5-claim batch on average.
Evidence freeze (copy + hash + redact private paths) enables deterministic re-verification across runs.
